newsitem.title: INDIA: Yield on Indian six-year gilt set at 13.82 percent.
newsitem.headline: Yield on Indian six-year gilt set at 13.82 percent.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Tuesday it set a cut-off yield of 13.82 percent at the 20 billion rupee auction of six-year government of India securities.
The RBI said it received 82 bids for 16.11 billion rupees of which it accepted 43 for 10.26 billion.
The RBI picked up securities for 8.73 billion rupees and the primary dealers 1.01 billion, it said.
The weighted-average yield worked out to 13.81 percent, it added.
